name: Pale Reach battlefield Grimepit Trogg corpses stay down (#9150)
contract: The Snowsong Valley Paladins-vs-Troggs battlefield decoration (rev_20261009_62_pale_reach_spawns) spawns Grimepit Troggs (entry 164206 guids 9960530-9960539, entry 164209 guids 9962102-9962106) with curhealth = 1 (live, not dead) and creature_addon bytes1 = 7 (UNIT_STAND_STATE_DEAD) so they lie as corpses. rev_20261017_77_pale_reach_npc_looks_poses's blanket creature_addon cleanup deleted all of them but only reinserted a handful of unrelated guids, so these guids lost their bytes1 = 7 row and reverted to the bytes1 = 0 (UNIT_STAND_STATE_STAND) default, standing upright with idle animation instead of lying dead.
